spanish: Y darás desde tu esplendor sobre él, a fin de que oigan toda congregación de hijos de Israel.

findings.issue: The 3mp verb has as its subject the whole congregation of the sons; plural oigan with singular congregación reads as an unnamed they hearing the congregation.
toda congregación without la can be read as every congregation; כל plus the construct ending in Israel is the whole of that one congregation.

notes: Y darás, desde tu esplendor, sobre él, a fin de que, and hijos de Israel match the remaining tokens.
